visa_type: Italy Digital Nomad / Remote Worker Visa

clarifications.title: Worker Route Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The Italy pathway requires selecting either the self-employed digital nomad route or the employee/collaborator remote worker route. The selected route is missing or unclear, so the case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Remote Worker Contract Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: Remote workers must provide an employment or collaboration contract, or a binding offer. Without this document, the case does not appear to meet the remote worker route requirements.

clarifications.title: Remote Worker Contract Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant's employment or collaboration contract status is unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether a qualifying contract or binding offer is available.

clarifications.title: Employer Clean-Record Declaration Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: For the remote worker route, the employer must provide a declaration that it has no relevant convictions in the previous 5 years. Without that declaration, the case does not appear to satisfy this route-specific requirement.

clarifications.title: Employer Declaration Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The employer clean-record declaration is missing or uncertain. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether the employer can provide the required declaration and signer identification.

clarifications.title: EU Citizen Status
clarifications.clarification: The Italy Digital Nomad / Remote Worker Visa pathway is for non-EU citizens. If the applicant is an EU citizen, this visa route does not appear to be the correct pathway.

clarifications.title: Nationality Status Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant's EU citizenship status is unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether the applicant is a non-EU citizen eligible to use this visa route.

clarifications.title: Remote Technology Work Not Confirmed
clarifications.clarification: This visa is for applicants performing highly qualified work remotely using technological tools. If the work will not be performed remotely with technological tools, the case does not appear to meet the core visa requirement.

clarifications.title: Remote Technology Work Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: It is unclear whether the applicant will perform highly qualified work remotely using technological tools while in Italy. The work arrangement should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Highly Qualified Basis Not Met
clarifications.clarification: The applicant must meet a highly qualified worker basis, such as a qualifying degree, regulated-profession attestation, 5 years of professional experience, or 3 years of ICT executive or specialist experience. If none applies, the case does not appear to qualify.

clarifications.title: Highly Qualified Basis Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant's highly qualified worker basis is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether the applicant can document one of the accepted qualification routes.

clarifications.title: Prior Experience Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant must prove at least 6 months of prior experience in the activity to be performed remotely from Italy. The amount of prior experience is missing or unclear and should be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Prior Experience Below Minimum
clarifications.clarification: Italy Digital Nomad / Remote Worker screening requires at least 6 months of prior experience in the activity to be performed. The provided experience is below that minimum.

clarifications.title: Income Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The annual income from the remote work to be performed in Italy is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether the applicant can document income meeting the Italy Digital Nomad / Remote Worker threshold.

clarifications.title: Income Below Minimum
clarifications.clarification: The source reference uses a conservative annual income threshold of EUR 25,500. The documented annual income from the remote work to be performed is below that threshold, so the case does not appear to meet the income requirement.

clarifications.title: Health Insurance Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: Applicants must have health insurance for medical care and hospitalization valid in Italy for the stay period. Based on the information provided, this requirement does not appear to be met.

clarifications.title: Health Insurance Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant's health insurance status is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm that valid medical and hospitalization coverage will be in place.

clarifications.title: Accommodation Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: Applicants must show suitable accommodation in Italy for the visa period, such as a registered lease, rental contract, or property deed. Based on the information provided, this requirement does not appear to be met.

clarifications.title: Accommodation Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant's accommodation status is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether suitable housing will be arranged for the visa period.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Passport validity is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed because consular requirements include passport validity beyond the intended stay.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity Below Minimum
clarifications.clarification: The source reference includes a minimum passport-validity requirement of at least 3 months beyond the stay. A passport below that minimum should be renewed before the case can qualify.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity Consular Threshold Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Some consular guidance lists a higher passport-validity threshold of 15 months beyond intended travel. The passport appears above the baseline minimum but below that consular threshold, so the case should be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Residence Permit Acknowledgment Missing
clarifications.clarification: Applicants must apply for a permesso di soggiorno within 8 working days of entering Italy. If the applicant will not comply with this requirement, the case does not appear to satisfy the after-entry compliance obligation.

clarifications.clarification: Self-employed digital nomads may need to request an Italian VAT number after entry. The applicant's understanding of this after-entry requirement is unclear and should be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Family Reunification Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant's family reunification intent is unclear. The case should be reviewed because family routing may affect document requirements and consular handling.

clarifications.title: Family Route Not Supported
clarifications.clarification: The reference notes spouse and minor children for the family route and does not support adult children or parents in this screening. A case seeking to include adult children or parents does not appear to fit this pathway's family route.
